# Büchi Emptiness — The Lasso Test

For a Büchi automaton $\mathcal{A}$, the language $L(\mathcal{A})$ is non-empty if and only if there exists an accepting state $q_f \in F$ that is:
1. **Reachable** from an initial state.
2. **On a cycle** (reachable from itself).

If such a state $q_f$ exists, the path from the initial state to $q_f$ is called the **stem** ($u$), and the cycle from $q_f$ back to $q_f$ is called the **period** ($v$). 
The automaton then accepts the ultimately periodic $\omega$-word $\alpha = u \cdot v^\omega$. This structure is called a **lasso**, and finding one is the core algorithm used in model checking to find counterexamples.

The first preset applies this directly to the running editor monitor: one
reachable cycle containing the accepting save-checkpoint proves that at least
one infinite execution saves forever.

---

## Widget: Find a Lasso

Select a Büchi automaton and click **Step $\rightarrow$** to search for a reachable accepting state on a cycle.

<script>
(function() {
  const PRESETS = [
    {
      svg: `<svg viewBox="0 0 400 180" style="width:100%;height:auto;">
        <defs><marker id="arr" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth"><path d="M0,0 L0,6 L8,3 z" fill="context-stroke"></path></marker></defs>
        <line x1="20" y1="100" x2="68" y2="100" stroke="#303036" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
        
        <g class="edge" id="e-q-q"><path d="M 80 82 C 60 40, 140 40, 120 82" marker-end="url(#arr)"/><text x="100" y="35" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="700">edit, idle</text></g>
        <g class="edge" id="e-q-f"><path d="M 128 90 C 160 60, 240 60, 272 90" marker-end="url(#arr)"/><text x="200" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="700">save</text></g>
        <g class="edge" id="e-f-q"><path d="M 272 110 C 240 140, 160 140, 128 110" marker-end="url(#arr)"/><text x="200" y="145" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="700">edit, idle</text></g>
        <g class="edge" id="e-f-f"><path d="M 280 82 C 260 40, 340 40, 320 82" marker-end="url(#arr)"/><text x="300" y="35" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="700">save</text></g>
        
        <g class="node" id="n-q" transform="translate(100,100)"><circle class="bg" r="28"/><text text-anchor="middle" dy="5" font-weight="700">q</text></g>
        <g class="node accept" id="n-f" transform="translate(300,100)"><circle class="outer" r="34"/><circle class="bg" r="28"/><text text-anchor="middle" dy="5" font-weight="700">f</text></g>
      </svg>`,
      steps: [
        { exp: "<b>Step 1: Find reachable states from initial state q.</b><br>R* = {q, f}", status: "R* = {q, f}", hl: ['q','f'], edges: [] },
        { exp: "<b>Step 2: Check if R* contains any accepting state.</b><br>F = {f}. So R* &cap; F = {f} &ne; &empty;.", status: "R* = {q, f}<br>Accepting in R*: {f}", hl: ['q','f'], target: 'f', edges: [] },
        { exp: "<b>Step 3: Can we reach f from f (is there a cycle)?</b><br>Yes, via the 'save' self-loop.", status: "Finding cycle for f... Found!", hl: ['q','f'], target: 'f', edges: ['e-f-f'] },
        { exp: "<b>Step 4: Extract the Lasso.</b><br>Stem (q to f): u = 'save'<br>Period (f to f): v = 'save'<br>&rarr; Language is <b>NON-EMPTY</b>.", status: "<div class='verdict-box verdict-pass'><b>NON-EMPTY</b><br>Lasso: (save) &middot; (save)<sup>&omega;</sup></div>", hl: ['q','f'], target: 'f', edges: ['e-q-f', 'e-f-f'] }
      ]
    },
    {
      svg: `<svg viewBox="0 0 380 260" style="width:100%;height:auto;">
        <defs><marker id="arr" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth"><path d="M0,0 L0,6 L8,3 z" fill="context-stroke"></path></marker></defs>
        <line x1="10" y1="80" x2="48" y2="80" stroke="#303036" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
        
        <g class="edge" id="e-q0-q0"><path d="M 60 62 C 40 20, 120 20, 100 62" marker-end="url(#arr)"/><text x="70" y="15" font-weight="700">b,c</text></g>
        <g class="edge" id="e-q0-q1"><path d="M 108 80 L 202 80" marker-end="url(#arr)"/><text x="150" y="70" font-weight="700">a</text></g>
        <g class="edge" id="e-q1-q1"><path d="M 220 62 C 200 20, 280 20, 260 62" marker-end="url(#arr)"/><text x="235" y="15" font-weight="700">a</text></g>
        <g class="edge" id="e-q1-q2"><path d="M 230 108 C 210 140, 210 180, 230 192" marker-end="url(#arr)"/><text x="195" y="155" font-weight="700">b,c</text></g>
        <g class="edge" id="e-q2-q1"><path d="M 250 192 C 270 180, 270 140, 250 108" marker-end="url(#arr)"/><text x="265" y="155" font-weight="700">b,c</text></g>
        
        <g class="node accept" id="n-q0" transform="translate(80,80)"><circle class="outer" r="34"/><circle class="bg" r="28"/><text text-anchor="middle" dy="5" font-weight="700">q&#x2080;</text></g>
        <g class="node accept" id="n-q1" transform="translate(240,80)"><circle class="outer" r="34"/><circle class="bg" r="28"/><text text-anchor="middle" dy="5" font-weight="700">q&#x2081;</text></g>
        <g class="node" id="n-q2" transform="translate(240,220)"><circle class="bg" r="28"/><text text-anchor="middle" dy="5" font-weight="700">q&#x2082;</text></g>
      </svg>`,
      steps: [
        { exp: "<b>Step 1: Find reachable states from initial state q0.</b><br>R* = {q0, q1, q2}", status: "R* = {q0, q1, q2}", hl: ['q0','q1','q2'], edges: [] },
        { exp: "<b>Step 2: Check if R* contains any accepting state.</b><br>F = {q0, q1}. So R* &cap; F = {q0, q1} &ne; &empty;.", status: "R* = {q0, q1, q2}<br>Accepting in R*: {q0, q1}", hl: ['q0','q1','q2'], target: 'q0', edges: [] },
        { exp: "<b>Step 3: Can we reach q0 from q0 (is there a cycle)?</b><br>Yes, via the 'b' (or 'c') self-loop.", status: "Finding cycle for q0... Found!", hl: ['q0','q1','q2'], target: 'q0', edges: ['e-q0-q0'] },
        { exp: "<b>Step 4: Extract the Lasso.</b><br>Stem (q0 to q0): u = &epsilon;<br>Period (q0 to q0): v = 'b'<br>&rarr; Language is <b>NON-EMPTY</b>.", status: "<div class='verdict-box verdict-pass'><b>NON-EMPTY</b><br>Lasso: &epsilon; &middot; (b)<sup>&omega;</sup></div>", hl: ['q0','q1','q2'], target: 'q0', edges: ['e-q0-q0'] }
      ]
    },
    {
      svg: `<svg viewBox="0 0 420 180" style="width:100%;height:auto;">
        <defs><marker id="arr" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth"><path d="M0,0 L0,6 L8,3 z" fill="context-stroke"></path></marker></defs>
        <line x1="10" y1="100" x2="48" y2="100" stroke="#303036" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
        
        <g class="edge" id="e-q0-q0"><path d="M 60 82 C 40 40, 120 40, 100 82" marker-end="url(#arr)"/><text x="70" y="35" font-weight="700">a</text></g>
        <g class="edge" id="e-q0-q2"><path d="M 108 100 L 202 100" marker-end="url(#arr)"/><text x="150" y="90" font-weight="700">b</text></g>
        <g class="edge" id="e-q2-q2"><path d="M 220 82 C 200 40, 280 40, 260 82" marker-end="url(#arr)"/><text x="225" y="35" font-weight="700">a,b</text></g>
        
        <g class="node" id="n-q0" transform="translate(80,100)"><circle class="bg" r="28"/><text text-anchor="middle" dy="5" font-weight="700">q&#x2080;</text></g>
        <g class="node" id="n-q2" transform="translate(240,100)"><circle class="bg" r="28"/><text text-anchor="middle" dy="5" font-weight="700">q&#x2082;</text></g>
        <g class="node accept" id="n-q1" transform="translate(360,100)"><circle class="outer" r="34"/><circle class="bg" r="28" style="fill:#f5f5f5;"/><text text-anchor="middle" dy="5" font-weight="700" fill="#999">q&#x2081;</text></g>
      </svg>`,
      steps: [
        { exp: "<b>Step 1: Find reachable states from initial state q0.</b><br>R* = {q0, q2}", status: "R* = {q0, q2}", hl: ['q0','q2'], edges: [] },
        { exp: "<b>Step 2: Check if R* contains any accepting state.</b><br>F = {q1}. So R* &cap; F = &empty;.<br>The only accepting state is unreachable.", status: "R* = {q0, q2}<br>Accepting in R*: None", hl: ['q0','q2'], target: null, edges: [] },
        { exp: "<b>Step 3: Conclude.</b><br>Since no accepting state is reachable, no accepting cycle can exist. Therefore L(A) = &empty;.", status: "<div class='verdict-box verdict-fail'><b>EMPTY</b><br>No reachable accepting state.</div>", hl: ['q0','q2'], target: null, edges: [] }
      ]
    }
  ];

  let stepIdx = 0;
  
  function loadPreset() {
    stepIdx = -1;
    const p = PRESETS[document.getElementById('nb14-preset').value];
    document.getElementById('nb14-svg-container').innerHTML = p.svg;
    document.getElementById('nb14-status').innerHTML = "Ready.";
    document.getElementById('nb14-explain').innerHTML = "Click <b>Step &rarr;</b> to begin emptiness check.";
    document.getElementById('nb14-progress').textContent = `Step 0 / ${p.steps.length}`;
    document.getElementById('nb14-step').disabled = false;
  }

  function renderStep() {
    const p = PRESETS[document.getElementById('nb14-preset').value];
    const s = p.steps[stepIdx];
    
    document.getElementById('nb14-explain').innerHTML = s.exp;
    document.getElementById('nb14-status').innerHTML = s.status;
    document.getElementById('nb14-progress').textContent = `Step ${stepIdx + 1} / ${p.steps.length}`;
    
    // Clear all highlights
    document.querySelectorAll('#nb14-svg-container .node').forEach(el => {
      el.classList.remove('reached', 'target');
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('#nb14-svg-container .edge').forEach(el => {
      el.classList.remove('active');
    });
    
    // Apply highlights
    if (s.hl) s.hl.forEach(id => document.getElementById(`n-${id}`).classList.add('reached'));
    if (s.target) document.getElementById(`n-${s.target}`).classList.add('target');
    if (s.edges) s.edges.forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).classList.add('active'));
    
    if (stepIdx === p.steps.length - 1) {
      document.getElementById('nb14-step').disabled = true;
    }
  }

  document.getElementById('nb14-step').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const p = PRESETS[document.getElementById('nb14-preset').value];
    if (stepIdx < p.steps.length - 1) {
      stepIdx++;
      renderStep();
    }
  });

  document.getElementById('nb14-reset').addEventListener('click', loadPreset);
  document.getElementById('nb14-preset').addEventListener('change', loadPreset);
  
  loadPreset();
})();
</script>
